summary: The proposed patch appears to be a minor fix for a regression issue, but it lacks documentation and may have a maintainability/readability defect.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor style inconsistency by changing a single line of code without updating the surrounding comments.
The patch may have a maintainability/readability defect due to the lack of a clear explanation for the change.
The patch lacks documentation and may benefit from additional tests to ensure its correctness.
